# ARICT Past Paper Portal

> A student-run archive of past examination papers for the Faculty of Applied Sciences at Rajarata University of Sri Lanka, maintained by the Association of Rajarata Information & Communication Technology (ARICT).

Canonical website: https://papers.arict.lk/

Students can search by subject code or subject name, filter by department, academic year and semester, preview available papers, download PDFs, and share paper links. A student account is not required. The portal also provides a form to request missing papers.

The five departments are Biological Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Computing, Health Promotion, and Physical Sciences. Academic year means the student's year of study (Years 1–4); examination period identifies the exam session. Availability varies by subject and examination period. Refer to the current paper pages for titles, course codes, examination periods and download links; this file does not contain the paper catalogue or PDF contents.

ARICT volunteers collect and organise these resources for study. The portal is not an official university examination notice service. Past papers do not predict future exams; students should confirm the current syllabus and examination format with their department. Paper requests do not guarantee availability.

For contributions, corrections and general enquiries, contact arict@as.rjt.ac.lk. Include the paper link or subject code where relevant. Papers are provided for personal, non-commercial study; consult the Terms of Use for details.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://papers.arict.lk/): Portal overview, search, department browsing and examination periods.
- [Past papers](https://papers.arict.lk/search): Search the available archive and open individual paper pages for metadata, PDF previews and downloads.
- [Faculty of Applied Sciences](https://papers.arict.lk/faculty): The five departments and links to their available papers.
- [About ARICT](https://papers.arict.lk/about): The student association, the archive's purpose and community contributions.
- [Help Center](https://papers.arict.lk/help): How to find, preview, download and share papers, request missing papers and report errors.
- [Contact ARICT](https://papers.arict.lk/contact): Contact details, paper contributions, corrections and ARICT social profiles.

## Optional

- [XML sitemap](https://papers.arict.lk/sitemap.xml): Canonical public page URLs and available paper URLs, generated from the archive. During a database outage, only the main pages may be listed.
- [Privacy Policy](https://papers.arict.lk/privacy): Handling of paper request details, browser preferences and third-party services.
- [Terms of Use](https://papers.arict.lk/terms): Personal study use, acceptable use, contributions and corrections.
- [Robots.txt](https://papers.arict.lk/robots.txt): Public crawler directives and the sitemap location.
